# Complete original Carbon build script

Source: <https://github.com/saarors/carbon-examples>, revision
`04026c7793552c49ffd19a0901b37c00691141b5`, original path `build.sh`.
The complete MIT license is retained as `LICENSE`; copyright remains upstream.

- `build.sh`: 498 physical bytes, 16 CRLF endings, SHA-256
  `27cfe6de0bb364c9e817cb6696fda31876f2b9087298931a94550c35f1c2b989`.
- `LICENSE`: 1,082 physical bytes, SHA-256
  `4822d7c5e7aa463737d58f672f18bf1a4be440fc67b15a1b7a9aa5e1a476400d`.
- Both upstream Git modes are `100644`; source blob
  `ced619ecf32e5e6890c0d5fa59349c8dd1020eba`, license blob
  `e74a40476191b0a23d4c02c2fb5b427ca90c99b0`. Git object identity and
  complete physical-checkout SHA-256 are distinct provenance measurements.

The fixture preserves the entire source, including the later loop and dynamic
command-name expansions. Tests parse it only; they never execute the shell or
Carbon compiler. A module argument Reference supplies no Calls authority.
